data.name: Muneerah
data.gender_notes: Muneerah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: She who guides, a light in the darkness. The name Muneerah carries the meaning “Guide, Light” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Muneerah usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of guidance and light in the spiritual journey
data.etymology: Muneerah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muneerah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
